name: Black Iron Sentinel
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

abilities.name: Ward Bond
abilities.description: The sentinel is magically bound to a ward of its choosing, and it can have only one ward at a time. While the sentinel is within 60 feet of its ward, half of any damage the ward takes (round up) is transferred to the sentinel.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.description: The sentinel regains 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point. If the sentinel takes cold damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the sentinel's next turn.

abilities.name: Interpose (Reaction)
abilities.description: When a creature within 5 feet of the sentinel that it guards is hit by an attack roll, the attack hits the sentinel instead, and the sentinel has Resistance to the attack's damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sentinel makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Ward Threshold (2/Day)
actions.description: The sentinel targets itself or one creature it can see within 60 feet. The target gains 24 (7d6) temporary hit points, and it gains a +2 bonus to AC until the end of the sentinel's next turn.

actions.name: Iron Root (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be restrained until the end of its next turn.

condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

generation.userConcept: a sentinel of black iron, AC 20, Huge, speed 20 feet
generation.cite: composition after Shield Guardian (CR 7) — Bound transfer, Regeneration, the measured 0.65 damage discount
